title: Diwali
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael organizes a Diwali celebration at the office to introduce coworkers to Indian culture, leading to a mix of humorous misunderstandings, cultural education, and social tensions. Pam is hesitant about attending, while Michael navigates both cultural presentation challenges and personal relationship moments, including a public proposal to Carol and a near-romantic moment with Pam. The episode also features interactions with Kelly’s family and various coworkers, highlighting cultural awareness and office dynamics, though the ultimate outcomes of the celebration and relationships remain uncertain.
